nodes.label: ADR 0001: Shell out to system git
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: shell out to system git
nodes.rationale: Git is already on every dev machine; credential helpers, gh and proxies already work through it; avoids a large go-git dependency with weaker partial-clone, credential and merge support.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 for cali.yaml
nodes.rationale: Maintained continuation of archived gopkg.in/yaml.v3; KnownFields rejects unknown keys; yaml.Node round-trip preserves comments.

nodes.label: ADR 0005: On-disk layout (config/data/cache)
nodes.rationale: Different lifetimes (committed, rebuildable, must-survive); XDG-style paths on macOS too so Mac, Linux and WSL follow one rule; env overrides make tests hermetic.

nodes.label: Cali Brief
nodes.rationale: Skills arrive via four install routes (APM, install.py, npx skills, plugin) and updates overwrite local edits; Cali replaces them with one command and one lockfile.
